gold: Primary signet-ring cell carcinoma of the bladder

selector.rationale: The vignette provides evidence of an adenocarcinoma with mucinous and signet-ring cell components in the bladder, which aligns with the characteristics of Urinary Bladder Adenocarcinoma, and the presence of specific cell types supports the consideration of subtypes like Signet-Ring Cell Adenocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Secondary adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: Lack of clear evidence for a secondary origin

rejected.label: Primary adenocarcinoma of the bladder
rejected.why: Too broad, as the specific type of adenocarcinoma is identified

rejected.label: Mucinous Adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: While present, not the most comprehensive diagnosis given the additional signet-ring cell component
